section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch48 — World Geography — Deep
subject: Social Studies
stem: The imaginary line of zero degrees longitude, from which all other longitudes are measured, passes through Greenwich in England and is called the:
explanation: The Prime Meridian (0° longitude) passes through Greenwich. The Equator is 0° latitude — a different reference line.

section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch48 — World Geography — Deep
subject: Social Studies
stem: The Sahara, the world's largest hot desert, is located on which continent?
explanation: The Sahara spans much of North Africa. The Gobi and Thar are major Asian deserts.
